+
+
+from sqlfluff.core import Linter
+
+
+def assert_copy_parses(sql: str, statement_type: str = "copy_statement") -> None:
+
+    parsed = Linter(dialect="vertica").parse_string(sql)
+    assert not parsed.violations, [str(violation) for violation in parsed.violations]
+    assert parsed.tree.raw == sql
+    assert "unparsable" not in parsed.tree.type_set()
+    assert len(list(parsed.tree.recursive_crawl(statement_type))) == 1
+
+
+def assert_copy_rejected(sql: str) -> None:
+
+    parsed = Linter(dialect="vertica").parse_string(sql)
+    assert parsed.violations
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_with_filter() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses(
+        "COPY events FROM 's3://bucket/events.csv' "
+        "WITH FILTER decompress() REJECTMAX 25;"
+    )
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_with_parser_and_local_native_source() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses(
+        "COPY events FROM LOCAL '/var/load/events.dat' NATIVE VARCHAR "
+        "WITH PARSER parse_events();"
+    )
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_on_node() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses("COPY events FROM 'events.dat' ON worker_node_1;")
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_on_any_node() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses("COPY events FROM 'events.dat' ON ANY NODE;")
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_extensions_compose_with_columns_and_options() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses(
+        "COPY events (event_id, payload FILLER VARCHAR(128)) "
+        "FROM 'events.orc' ORC WITH PARSER parse_events() "
+        "WITH FILTER decompress() ON worker_node_1 TRAILING NULLCOLS;"
+    )
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_extensions_follow_source() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_rejected("COPY events WITH PARSER parse_events() FROM 'events.csv';")
+    assert_copy_rejected("COPY events WITH FILTER decompress() FROM 'events.csv';")
+
+
+def test_vertica_copy_extensions_require_operands() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_rejected("COPY events FROM 'events.csv' WITH FILTER;")
+    assert_copy_rejected("COPY events FROM 'events.csv' ON;")
+
+
+def test_vertica_external_table_copy_extensions() -> None:
+
+    assert_copy_parses(
+        "CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ext_events (event_id INT) AS COPY "
+        "FROM 'events.orc' ORC WITH PARSER parse_events() "
+        "WITH FILTER decompress() ON worker_node_1;",
+        statement_type="create_external_table_statement",
+    )
+
+

+
+    assert_copy_parses(
+        "CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ext_events (event_id INT) AS COPY "
+        "COLUMN OPTION (payload FILLER VARCHAR(128)) FROM 'events.csv' "
+        "WITH FILTER decompress() ON ANY NODE;",

+

+
+

+import os
+import re
+
+import pytest
+
+from fabulous import grapefruit, utils
+from fabulous.text import FontNotFound, Text, get_font_files, resolve_font
+
+
+BUNDLED_NOTO_SANS = "/workspace/repo/fabulous/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf"
+BUNDLED_NOTO_EMOJI = "/workspace/repo/fabulous/fonts/NotoEmoji-Regular.ttf"
+ANSI_ESCAPE_RE = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m")
+
+
+class FixedTerminal(object):
+    width = 79
+    bgcolor = grapefruit.Color.NewFromHtml("black")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def fixed_terminal(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "term", FixedTerminal())
+
+
+def render_observables(obj):
+    rows = list(obj)
+    non_empty = [row for row in rows if row]
+    rendered = str(obj)
+    return {
+        "size": getattr(obj, "size", None),
+        "rows": len(rows),
+        "non_empty_rows": len(non_empty),
+        "str_len": len(rendered),
+        "newlines": rendered.count("\n"),
+        "rendered": rendered,
+        "has_ansi": bool(ANSI_ESCAPE_RE.search(rendered)),
+        "text": getattr(obj, "text", None),
+    }
+
+
+def assert_terminal_renderable(actual):
+
+
+    assert actual["rows"] > 0
+    assert actual["non_empty_rows"] > 0
+    assert actual["str_len"] > 0
+    assert actual["has_ansi"] == True
+    if actual["size"] is not None:
+        assert actual["size"][0] > 0
+        assert actual["size"][1] > 0
+
+
+def test_shadow_and_skew_text_renders_ansi_rows():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = render_observables(Text("Fabulous", shadow=True, skew=5))
+    plain = render_observables(Text("Fabulous"))
+
+    assert_terminal_renderable(actual)
+
+
+    assert actual["rendered"] != plain["rendered"]
+    if actual["text"] is not None:
+        assert actual["text"] == "Fabulous"
+
+
+def test_named_bundled_font_plain_text_default_options():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = render_observables(Text("lorem ipsum", font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+    different_text = render_observables(Text("ipsum lorem", font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+
+    assert_terminal_renderable(actual)
+
+
+    assert actual["rendered"] != different_text["rendered"]
+    if actual["text"] is not None:
+        assert actual["text"] == "lorem ipsum"
+
+
+def test_unicode_emoji_text_preserves_input_and_renders():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = render_observables(Text("😃", font="NotoEmoji-Regular"))
+
+    assert_terminal_renderable(actual)
+
+
+    if actual["text"] is not None:
+        assert actual["text"] == "😃"
+
+
+def test_css_color_name_and_custom_font_size_are_applied():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = render_observables(Text("RGB", color="red", font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+    default_color = render_observables(Text("RGB", font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+
+    assert_terminal_renderable(actual)
+
+
+    assert actual["rendered"] != default_color["rendered"]
+    if actual["text"] is not None:
+        assert actual["text"] == "RGB"
+
+
+def test_hex_color_and_smaller_font_size_are_applied():
+
+
+
+
+    actual = render_observables(Text("RGB", color="#00ff00", fsize=18, font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+    default_size = render_observables(Text("RGB", color="#00ff00", font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+    red_same_size = render_observables(Text("RGB", color="red", fsize=18, font="NotoSans-Bold"))
+
+    assert_terminal_renderable(actual)
+
+
+    assert actual["rendered"] != default_size["rendered"]
+    assert actual["rendered"] != red_same_size["rendered"]
+    if actual["size"] is not None and default_size["size"] is not None:
+        assert actual["size"][0] < default_size["size"][0]
+        assert actual["size"][1] < default_size["size"][1]
+    if actual["text"] is not None:
+        assert actual["text"] == "RGB"

+    actual = render_observables(Text("Abs", font=BUNDLED_NOTO_SANS))

+
+
+def test_iteration_is_repeatable_for_same_text_object():
+
+
+
+
+    obj = Text("Hi", font="NotoSans-Bold")
+
+    first_rows = list(obj)
+    second_rows = list(obj)
+    rendered = str(obj)
+
+
+
+    assert len(first_rows) > 0
+    assert len([row for row in first_rows if row]) > 0

+    assert len(rendered) > 0

+package cmd
+
+import (
+	"bytes"

+	"path/filepath"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/chanzuckerberg/fogg/util"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+
+const dockerWarningText = "Docker support is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of fogg."
+
+func minimalConfigWithDocker(t *testing.T, docker bool) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	b, err := util.TestFile("v2_minimal_valid")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	var conf map[string]interface{}
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(b, &conf))
+	conf["docker"] = docker
+
+	out, err := json.Marshal(conf)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return out
+}
+
+func runFoggCommandWithConfig(t *testing.T, command string, config []byte) (string, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	require.NoError(t, exec.Command("git", "init", dir).Run())
+
+	configPath := filepath.Join(dir, "fogg.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(configPath, config, 0600))
+
+	oldWd, err := os.Getwd()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, os.Chdir(dir))
+	defer func() {
+		require.NoError(t, os.Chdir(oldWd))
+	}()
+
+	var logOutput bytes.Buffer
+
+	previousLogOutput := logrus.StandardLogger().Out
+	previousFormatter := logrus.StandardLogger().Formatter
+	defer func() {
+		logrus.SetOutput(previousLogOutput)
+		logrus.SetFormatter(previousFormatter)
+	}()
+	logrus.SetOutput(&logOutput)
+	logrus.SetFormatter(&logrus.TextFormatter{DisableTimestamp: true})
+
+	rootCmd.SetArgs([]string{command, "--config", "fogg.yml"})
+
+	output, err := captureStdoutStderr(t, rootCmd.Execute)
+	return logOutput.String() + output, err
+}
+
+func captureStdoutStderr(t *testing.T, run func() error) (string, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	oldStdout := os.Stdout
+	oldStderr := os.Stderr
+	stdoutR, stdoutW, err := os.Pipe()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	stderrR, stderrW, err := os.Pipe()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	os.Stdout = stdoutW
+	os.Stderr = stderrW
+	defer func() {
+		os.Stdout = oldStdout
+		os.Stderr = oldStderr
+	}()
+
+	var stdout bytes.Buffer
+	var stderr bytes.Buffer
+	var wg sync.WaitGroup
+	wg.Add(2)
+	go func() {
+		defer wg.Done()
+		_, _ = io.Copy(&stdout, stdoutR)
+	}()
+	go func() {
+		defer wg.Done()
+		_, _ = io.Copy(&stderr, stderrR)
+	}()
+
+	runErr := run()
+	require.NoError(t, stdoutW.Close())
+	require.NoError(t, stderrW.Close())
+	wg.Wait()
+	require.NoError(t, stdoutR.Close())
+	require.NoError(t, stderrR.Close())
+
+	return stdout.String() + stderr.String(), runErr
+}

+
+  @decorators.SetParseFns(count=int)

+

+

+
+  @decorators.SetParseFn(str)

+
+

+
+  @decorators.SetParseFns(int)

+
+

+
+  @decorators.SetParseFns(count=int)
+  def double(self, count):
+    return 2 * count
+

+

+

+
+

+
+
+

+

+
+

+import gc
+import socket
+import unittest
+
+from supervisor.datatypes import InetStreamSocketConfig
+from supervisor.datatypes import UnixStreamSocketConfig
+from supervisor.options import ServerOptions
+from supervisor.options import UnhosedConfigParser
+from supervisor.socket_manager import SocketManager
+
+
+class SocketBacklogConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _parse_fcgi(self, socket_value, backlog_line=None, expansions=None):
+        extra = '' if backlog_line is None else '\n' + backlog_line
+        text = ('[fcgi-program:backlog]\n'
+                'socket = %s%s\n'
+                'command = /bin/true\n' % (socket_value, extra))
+        parser = UnhosedConfigParser()
+        parser.expansions = expansions or {}
+        parser.read_string(text)
+        return ServerOptions().process_groups_from_parser(parser)[0].socket_config
+
+    def _backlog(self, config):
+        getter = getattr(config, 'get_backlog', None)
+        return getter() if getter is not None else None
+
+    def test_socket_configs_store_explicit_backlog(self):
+        inet = InetStreamSocketConfig('127.0.0.1', 49101, backlog=17)
+        unix = UnixStreamSocketConfig('/tmp/supervisor-backlog-test.sock',
+                                      backlog=23)
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(inet), 17)
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(unix), 23)
+
+    def test_parser_applies_backlog_to_unix_and_tcp(self):
+        unix = self._parse_fcgi('unix:///tmp/supervisor-backlog-unix.sock',
+                                'socket_backlog = 19')
+        inet = self._parse_fcgi('tcp://127.0.0.1:49102',
+                                'socket_backlog = 29')
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(unix), 19)
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(inet), 29)
+
+    def test_parser_default_preserves_system_backlog(self):
+        unix = self._parse_fcgi('unix:///tmp/supervisor-backlog-default.sock')
+        inet = self._parse_fcgi('tcp://127.0.0.1:49103')
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(unix), socket.SOMAXCONN)
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(inet), socket.SOMAXCONN)
+
+    def test_parser_expands_environment_backlog(self):
+        cfg = self._parse_fcgi('tcp://127.0.0.1:49104',
+                               'socket_backlog = %(ENV_BACKLOG)s',
+                               {'ENV_BACKLOG': '31'})
+        self.assertEqual(self._backlog(cfg), 31)
+
+    def test_parser_rejects_non_positive_or_non_numeric_backlog(self):
+        for value in ('0', '-1', 'not-a-number'):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    self._parse_fcgi('tcp://127.0.0.1:49105',
+                                     'socket_backlog = %s' % value)
+
+
+class SocketManagerBacklogTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    class RecordingSocket:
+        def __init__(self, listen_error=None):
+            self.listen_backlog = None
+            self.listen_error = listen_error
+            self.close_called = False
+
+        def listen(self, backlog):
+            if self.listen_error is not None:
+                raise self.listen_error
+            self.listen_backlog = backlog
+
+        def close(self):
+            self.close_called = True
+
+    class Config:
+        url = 'tcp://recording:1'
+
+        def __init__(self, backlog):
+            self.backlog = backlog
+            self.created = None
+
+        def create_and_bind(self):
+            self.created = SocketManagerBacklogTests.RecordingSocket()
+            return self.created
+
+        def get_backlog(self):
+            return self.backlog
+
+    class LegacyConfig:
+        url = 'unix:///legacy'
+
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.created = None
+
+        def create_and_bind(self):
+            self.created = SocketManagerBacklogTests.RecordingSocket()
+            return self.created
+
+    class RetryConfig:
+        url = 'tcp://recording:2'
+
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.fail = True
+            self.created = None
+
+        def create_and_bind(self):
+            error = socket.error('listen failed') if self.fail else None
+            self.created = SocketManagerBacklogTests.RecordingSocket(error)
+            return self.created
+
+        def get_backlog(self):
+            return 41
+
+    def test_manager_passes_configured_backlog_to_listen(self):
+        config = self.Config(37)
+        sock = SocketManager(config).get_socket()
+        self.assertEqual(config.created.listen_backlog, 37)
+        del sock
+        gc.collect()
+
+    def test_manager_keeps_default_for_legacy_socket_config(self):
+        config = self.LegacyConfig()
+        sock = SocketManager(config).get_socket()
+        self.assertEqual(config.created.listen_backlog, socket.SOMAXCONN)
+        del sock
+        gc.collect()
+
+    def test_listen_failure_closes_socket_and_allows_retry(self):
+        config = self.RetryConfig()
+        manager = SocketManager(config)
+        with self.assertRaises(socket.error):
+            manager.get_socket()
+        self.assertTrue(config.created.close_called)
+        self.assertFalse(manager.is_prepared())
+
+        config.fail = False
+        sock = manager.get_socket()
+        self.assertEqual(config.created.listen_backlog, 41)
+        self.assertTrue(manager.is_prepared())
+        del sock
+        gc.collect()
+        self.assertFalse(manager.is_prepared())
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+package usercase_test_coderl
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gopxl/pixel/v2"
+	"github.com/gopxl/pixel/v2/backends/opengl"
+)
+
+func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
+	opengl.Run(func() {
+		os.Exit(m.Run())
+	})
+}
+
+func TestTypedCollectsCharactersUntilFrameUpdate(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	win := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-ab")
+	defer win.Destroy()
+
+	id := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-ab")
+	drainInput(win)
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "ab")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "ab")
+
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+}
+
+func TestTypedReturnsUnicodeUTF8Text(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	mapEacuteKey(t)
+	win := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-unicode")
+	defer win.Destroy()
+
+	id := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-unicode")
+	drainInput(win)
+	sendXDo(t, "key", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "eacute")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "é")
+	if got := fmt.Sprintf("% x", []byte(win.Typed())); got != "c3 a9" {
+		t.Fatalf("Typed() bytes = %q, want %q", got, "c3 a9")
+	}
+
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+}
+
+func TestTypedClearsAfterEachInputAdvanceVariant(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	win := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-advance")
+	defer win.Destroy()
+
+	id := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-advance")
+	drainInput(win)
+
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "c")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "c")
+	win.Update()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "d")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "d")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "e")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "e")
+	win.UpdateInputWait(20 * time.Millisecond)
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+}
+
+func TestNonTextKeyStateIsSeparateFromTypedText(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	win := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-nontext")
+	defer win.Destroy()
+
+	id := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-nontext")
+	drainInput(win)
+	sendXDo(t, "keydown", "--window", id, "Escape", "Left", "F1")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyEscape, true)
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyLeft, true)
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyF1, true)
+
+	sendXDo(t, "keyup", "--window", id, "Escape", "Left", "F1")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "")
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyEscape, false)
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyLeft, false)
+	assertPressed(t, win, pixel.KeyF1, false)
+}
+
+func TestTypedBuffersAreIndependentPerWindow(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+	a := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-independent-a")
+	defer a.Destroy()
+	b := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-independent-b")
+	defer b.Destroy()
+
+	aID := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-independent-a")
+	drainInput(a)
+	drainInput(b)
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", aID, "--delay", "0", "x")
+	a.UpdateInput()
+	b.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, a, "x")
+	assertTyped(t, b, "")
+
+	bID := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-independent-b")
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", bID, "--delay", "0", "y")
+	a.UpdateInput()
+	b.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, a, "")
+	assertTyped(t, b, "y")
+}
+
+func TestTypedWorksForNewWindowCreateUseDestroy(t *testing.T) {
+
+
+
+	win := newWindow(t, "pixel-typed-create-use-destroy")
+	id := focusWindow(t, "pixel-typed-create-use-destroy")
+	drainInput(win)
+	sendXDo(t, "type", "--window", id, "--delay", "0", "q")
+	win.UpdateInput()
+	assertTyped(t, win, "q")
+	win.Destroy()
+}
+
+func newWindow(t *testing.T, title string) *opengl.Window {
+	t.Helper()
+	win, err := opengl.NewWindow(opengl.WindowConfig{
+		Title:  title,
+		Bounds: pixel.R(0, 0, 160, 120),
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("NewWindow(%q) failed: %v", title, err)
+	}
+	return win
+}
+
+func focusWindow(t *testing.T, title string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
+	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		out, err := exec.Command("xdotool", "search", "--name", title).CombinedOutput()
+		if err == nil {
+			fields := strings.Fields(string(out))
+			if len(fields) > 0 {
+				sendXDo(t, "windowfocus", fields[0])
+				return fields[0]
+			}
+		}
+		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	t.Fatalf("could not find X window with title %q", title)
+	return ""
+}
+
+func drainInput(win *opengl.Window) {
+	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
+		win.UpdateInputWait(20 * time.Millisecond)
+	}
+}
+
+func sendXDo(t *testing.T, args ...string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	cmd := exec.Command("xdotool", args...)
+	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("xdotool %s failed: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, out)
+	}
+	time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
+}
+
+func mapEacuteKey(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Helper()
+	cmd := exec.Command("xmodmap", "-e", "keycode 49 = eacute Eacute eacute Eacute")
+	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("xmodmap eacute binding failed: %v\n%s", err, out)
+	}
+}
+
+func assertTyped(t *testing.T, win *opengl.Window, want string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if got := win.Typed(); got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("Typed() = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func assertPressed(t *testing.T, win *opengl.Window, button pixel.Button, want bool) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if got := win.Pressed(button); got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("Pressed(%v) = %t, want %t", button, got, want)
+	}
+}

+use arrow2::{array::*, compute::lower::*, error::Result};
+
+fn with_nulls_utf8<O: Offset>() -> Result<()> {
+    let cases = vec![
+
+        (
+            vec![Some("hello"), None, Some("world")],
+            vec![Some("hello"), None, Some("world")],
+        ),
+
+        (
+            vec![Some("Hello"), None, Some("wOrld")],
+            vec![Some("hello"), None, Some("world")],
+        ),
+
+        (
+            vec![Some("HELLO"), None, Some("WORLD")],
+            vec![Some("hello"), None, Some("world")],
+        ),
+
+        (
+            vec![
+                None,
+                Some("السلام عليكم"),
+                Some("Dobrý den"),
+                Some("שָׁלוֹם"),
+                Some("नमस्ते"),
+                Some("こんにちは"),
+                Some("안녕하세요"),
+                Some("你好"),
+                Some("Olá"),
+                Some("Здравствуйте"),
+                Some("Hola"),
+            ],
+            vec![
+                None,
+                Some("السلام عليكم"),
+                Some("dobrý den"),
+                Some("שָׁלוֹם"),
+                Some("नमस्ते"),
+                Some("こんにちは"),
+                Some("안녕하세요"),
+                Some("你好"),
+                Some("olá"),
+                Some("здравствуйте"),
+                Some("hola"),
+            ],
+        ),
+    ];
+
+    cases
+        .into_iter()
+        .try_for_each::<_, Result<()>>(|(array, expected)| {
+            let array = Utf8Array::<O>::from(&array);
+            let result = lower(&array)?;
+            assert_eq!(array.len(), result.len());
+
+            let result = result.as_any().downcast_ref::<Utf8Array<O>>().unwrap();
+            let expected = Utf8Array::<O>::from(&expected);
+
+            assert_eq!(&expected, result);
+            Ok(())
+        })?;
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+#[test]

+        (vec!["Hello", "wOrld"], vec!["hello", "world"]),
+
+        (vec!["HELLO", "WORLD"], vec!["hello", "world"]),
+
+        (
+            vec![
+                "السلام عليكم",
+                "Dobrý den",
+                "שָׁלוֹם",
+                "नमस्ते",
+                "こんにちは",
+                "안녕하세요",
+                "你好",
+                "Olá",
+                "Здравствуйте",
+                "Hola",
+            ],
+            vec![
+                "السلام عليكم",
+                "dobrý den",
+                "שָׁלוֹם",
+                "नमस्ते",
+                "こんにちは",
+                "안녕하세요",
+                "你好",
+                "olá",
+                "здравствуйте",
+                "hola",
+            ],
+        ),
+    ];
+
+    cases
+        .into_iter()
+        .try_for_each::<_, Result<()>>(|(array, expected)| {
+            let array = Utf8Array::<O>::from_slice(&array);
+            let result = lower(&array)?;
+            assert_eq!(array.len(), result.len());
+
+            let result = result.as_any().downcast_ref::<Utf8Array<O>>().unwrap();
+            let expected = Utf8Array::<O>::from_slice(&expected);
+            assert_eq!(&expected, result);
+            Ok(())
+        })?;
+
+    Ok(())
+}

+

+
+

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        scores: list[float],
+        multi_metrics: list[list[float]],
+        weighted_metrics: list[list[float]],
+        expected_simulated_pose_columns: list | None = None,

+        self._scores = np.array(scores, dtype=float)
+        self._multi_metrics = np.array(multi_metrics, dtype=float)
+        self._weighted_metrics = np.array(weighted_metrics, dtype=float)

+        self.calls: list[np.ndarray] = []

+    def score_proposals(

+        centerline: object,
+        route_lane_ids: object,

#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /testbed

# Use Go 1.23 (pre-installed, needed for this GOPATH-based project)
export PATH="/opt/go-1.23/bin:$PATH"

# Set up GOPATH mode for this older TiDB codebase
export GO111MODULE=off
export GOPATH=/testbed/_vendor
export CGO_ENABLED=1

# Symlink the repo into the vendor GOPATH so imports resolve
mkdir -p /testbed/_vendor/src/github.com/pingcap
ln -sfn /testbed /testbed/_vendor/src/github.com/pingcap/tidb

# Build goyacc and generate parser.go (not tracked in git)
GO111MODULE=off GOPATH=/testbed/_vendor CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o bin/goyacc parser/goyacc/main.go
bin/goyacc -o /dev/null -xegen temp_parser_file parser/parser.y
bin/goyacc -o parser/parser.go -xe temp_parser_file parser/parser.y 2>&1 || true
rm -f temp_parser_file y.output

# Fix generated parser.go (strip //line directives, fix EOF token name, add generated header)
sed -i -e 's|//line.*||' -e 's/yyEofCode/yyEOFCode/' parser/parser.go
awk 'BEGIN{print "// Code generated by goyacc"} {print}' parser/parser.go > tmp_parser.go && mv tmp_parser.go parser/parser.go

# Remove trailing invalid bytes that goyacc may leave
head -n -1 parser/parser.go > parser/parser_clean.go 2>/dev/null && mv parser/parser_clean.go parser/parser.go || true

# Run the two target test packages
GO111MODULE=off GOPATH=/testbed/_vendor CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -v github.com/pingcap/tidb/expression github.com/pingcap/tidb/plan

+import ast

+import unittest
+
+from bugbear import BugBearChecker
+
+
+B028_MESSAGE = "B028 No explicit stacklevel argument found."
+
+
+def b028_diagnostics(source):
+    source = textwrap.dedent(source).lstrip("\n")
+    checker = BugBearChecker(
+        tree=ast.parse(source),
+        lines=source.splitlines(keepends=True),
+        filename="b028_contract_sample.py",
+    )
+    return [
+        (line, column, message)
+        for line, column, message, _ in checker.run()
+        if message.startswith("B028")
+    ]
+
+
+class B028StacklevelContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_reports_standard_warn_calls_through_supported_import_forms(self):
+        source = """
+            import warnings
+            import warnings as warning_tools
+            from warnings import warn
+            from warnings import warn as emit_warning
+
+            warnings.warn("canonical")
+            warning_tools.warn("module alias")
+            warn("direct import")
+            emit_warning("direct alias")
+        """
+        self.assertEqual(
+            b028_diagnostics(source),
+            [
+                (6, 0, B028_MESSAGE),
+                (7, 0, B028_MESSAGE),
+                (8, 0, B028_MESSAGE),
+                (9, 0, B028_MESSAGE),

+        )

+import sys
+import types
+
+from PyQt5.QtCore import QObject
+from PyQt5.QtGui import QPainterPath
+from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QGraphicsItem, QGraphicsScene
+
+
+
+
+sys.modules.setdefault("urh.cythonext.path_creator", types.SimpleNamespace())
+sys.modules.setdefault("urh.cythonext.util", types.SimpleNamespace())
+sys.modules.setdefault(
+    "urh.cythonext.signalFunctions",
+    types.SimpleNamespace(get_noise_for_mod_type=lambda _mod_type: 0),
+)
+
+from urh.FFTSceneManager import FFTSceneManager
+from urh.SceneManager import SceneManager
+from urh.SignalSceneManager import SignalSceneManager
+
+_APP = None
+
+def _ensure_app():
+    global _APP
+    app = QApplication.instance()
+    if not isinstance(app, QApplication):
+        app = QApplication(sys.argv)
+    _APP = app
+    return app
+
+
+def _value(obj, attr_name):
+    return getattr(obj, attr_name, None)
+
+
+def _snapshot_base_resources(manager):
+    return {
+        "scene": manager.scene,
+        "plot_data": _value(manager, "plot_data"),
+        "line_item": _value(manager, "line_item"),
+        "text_item": _value(manager, "text_item"),
+    }
+
+
+def _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, attr_name, previous_value):
+    if previous_value is not None:
+        assert _value(manager, attr_name) is not previous_value
+
+
+def _assert_no_graphics_item_retained(manager, attr_name):
+    value = _value(manager, attr_name)
+    assert value is None or not isinstance(value, QGraphicsItem)
+
+
+def _assert_scene_resource_released(manager, previous_scene):
+    current_scene = _value(manager, "scene")
+    if current_scene is previous_scene:
+        assert previous_scene.parent() is None
+        assert len(previous_scene.items()) == 0
+    else:
+        assert current_scene is None or not isinstance(current_scene, QGraphicsScene)
+
+
+def _assert_base_resources_released(manager, before):
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "plot_data", before["plot_data"])
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "line_item", before["line_item"])
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "text_item", before["text_item"])
+    _assert_no_graphics_item_retained(manager, "line_item")
+    _assert_no_graphics_item_retained(manager, "text_item")
+    _assert_scene_resource_released(manager, before["scene"])
+
+
+def _minimal_fft_manager():
+    _ensure_app()
+    manager = FFTSceneManager(QObject())
+    manager.peak = [1, 2, 3]
+    manager.plot_data = [0.125, 0.25, 0.5]
+    if getattr(manager, "peak_item", None) is None:
+        manager.peak_item = manager.scene.addPath(QPainterPath())
+    return manager
+
+
+def _minimal_signal_manager(signal):
+    _ensure_app()
+    return SignalSceneManager(signal, QObject())
+
+
+def test_new_scene_manager_has_no_plot_data():
+    _ensure_app()
+    manager = SceneManager(QObject())
+
+    assert manager.plot_data is None
+
+
+def test_scene_manager_eliminate_releases_base_resources():
+    _ensure_app()
+    manager = SceneManager(QObject())
+    manager.plot_data = [0.25, -0.5, 1.0]
+    before = _snapshot_base_resources(manager)
+    scene_parent = QObject()
+    before["scene"].setParent(scene_parent)
+
+    assert len(before["scene"].items()) >= 2
+
+    manager.eliminate()
+
+    _assert_base_resources_released(manager, before)
+
+
+def test_fft_scene_manager_eliminate_releases_peak_state():
+    manager = _minimal_fft_manager()
+    before = _snapshot_base_resources(manager)
+    peak = manager.peak
+    peak_item = manager.peak_item
+    scene_parent = QObject()
+    before["scene"].setParent(scene_parent)
+
+    manager.eliminate()
+
+    _assert_base_resources_released(manager, before)
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "peak", peak)
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "peak_item", peak_item)
+    _assert_no_graphics_item_retained(manager, "peak_item")
+
+
+def test_signal_scene_manager_eliminate_releases_signal_reference():
+    sentinel_signal = object()
+    manager = _minimal_signal_manager(sentinel_signal)
+    before = _snapshot_base_resources(manager)
+    scene_parent = QObject()
+    before["scene"].setParent(scene_parent)
+
+    manager.eliminate()
+
+    _assert_base_resources_released(manager, before)
+    _assert_not_retaining_previous(manager, "signal", sentinel_signal)
+
+
+def test_clear_peak_after_eliminate_is_safe():
+    manager = _minimal_fft_manager()
+
+    manager.eliminate()
+
+    manager.clear_peak()
+    _assert_no_graphics_item_retained(manager, "peak_item")

+		close(done)
